title: Blade OML angular position, hub A datum to blade OML, at the full-sweep-average sensitivity (degrees)

provenance.why_this_file_exists: Same topology, same selection, same chain order, DIFFERENT transform set -- the second of the source workbook's two parallel result columns. It is the case that made a per-study `transforms` map the right shape rather than putting sensitivities only on edges: two sensitivity sets over one graph is not two graphs, and a schema that forced it to be would double every future edit.
provenance.one_override_the_worst_case_study_does_n: `pitch_arm_link_hole_to_clocking_hole` IS in the map here. Its own default is the worst-case blade-root coupling, so the average-condition study has to override it -- the only edge in the repo where a study overrides a non-identity default, and the reason the override map layers over defaults rather than replacing the field.

notes: The ratios are the source sheet's F10/F11 -- described there as the full-sweep-average motion ratio and explicitly not a literal average over angle. Placeholders, like every ratio in this topology.

Comparing this study's total with `pitch_system_blade_angle_worst`'s is the whole point of holding both: the ratio of the two is the ratio of the two sensitivity columns, and nothing about the structure changed.
